source.reference: Verification manual of a commercial slope stability program.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V004b (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Baker (2003) prints only F = 2.64 and σmax = 78.1 kPa for this example (p. 390, Fig. 5); the iterated parameters c′ = 2.439 kPa, φ′ = 30.392° are a commercial program manual's. Baker's eq. (3) gives c ≈ 2.54, φ ≈ 30.30 (docs/kallor/baker-2003.md).
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
